newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing early gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing early gains.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Monday after some contracts erased earlier gains by the afternoon session, but trading was thin as local investors are now more interested in sugar and soybean, traders said.
Prices ranged from 180 yen lower to 70 yen higher at the close, with the benchmark July 1998 contract down 180 yen at 13,610 yen a tonne.
All contracts gained during the morning session, due to the yen's weaker sentiment against the dollar, but the lower CBOT overnight corn trading triggered light selling later, traders said.
The spot September corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was trading at $2.40-1/2 per bushel at 0820 GMT, against $2.43-1/4 at Friday's close.
The spot August CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.50 per bushel at 0820 GMT, against $7.54-1/2 at Friday's close.
